title: Abelian pro-etale closed direct image preserves filtered colimits
statement: For a closed immersion i:Z to X of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], with X quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], the concrete abelian direct-image functor on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] preserves colimits of every small filtered diagram shape [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-size-convention].

source.place: Tag 0738 (4) and Tag 098D; abelian geometric part of parent proof step 5.

proof.text: Evaluate the colimit comparison on an affine covering basis. Such an object V and its closed fibre V_Z are qcqs. Localization identifies evaluation with global sections on their own pro-etale sites and preserves colimits. The first clause of the qcqs section-calculus theorem commutes these sections with filtered colimits. The direct-image formula identifies both sides with the same colimit of sections at V_Z, compatibly with coprojections. The comparison is thus invertible on a covering basis and hence globally.
